steps.name: core-hardening
steps.summary: Fixed 7 review defects test-first (I-050..I-056): SessionStore.subscribe(id, onChange, onError?) and the SSE route closes on listener error (MemoryStore.failSubscribers for tests); FirestoreStore caches only a successful init (injectable loader, firestore.test.ts); setDineOption change in confirming bumps cartVersion; sessionSecrets.recentResults (last 10, server only) replays a duplicate's result, a repeated reissueClaim rotates again before paying; ACTOR_SOURCES binds source to actor (phone voice/text/button, kiosk touch, else BAD_REQUEST) in applyCommand; shared SESSION_ID regex + sessionId zod schema in commands/schemas.ts for envelope, ping, claim, SSE; IPv6 rate-limit keyed by /64. Also :lang(ko) keep-all in globals.css and devIndicators:false (I-057). ARCHITECTURE, SECURITY and docs/ko updated per R-002. Phone code must send source button only from real taps.

steps.name: agent-core
steps.summary: src/lib/agent/: menu.ts menuForModel (compact menu, no images/theme; groups with id/name/appliesTo/required/min/max/default/options{id,name,priceDelta,soldOut}); tools.ts toolDeclarations(kiosk) = 9 FunctionDeclarations with parametersJsonSchema (itemId/groupId/optionId enums from the catalog; updateCart takes flat lineId/qty/variant/options; callStaff without learned_mismatch); mapping.ts toolCallToCommand (zod shape check, options[] merged into a selections record, updateCart fields under changes, unknown tool or bad shape -> CommandError BAD_REQUEST) and toolResult ({ok,status,total,cart[{lineId,name,variant,options,qty,unitPrice}],upsell?} or {ok:false,code,message,templateId?,choices?[{kind,id,name}]}; templateId added so the model can call offerChoices; never tokens, claimToken or cartVersion), plus cartForModel; choices.ts choiceLabel/choiceQuestion (menu data + fixed ko/en words, empty label for unknown ids); instructions.ts buildInstructions(kiosk,{cart,status,dineOption,locale}) with grounding/staff, choices, upsell once, confirm rule (never requestCheckout+confirmCheckout in one turn, tap on 'Please confirm on the card.'), current order block 'already applied', and a <menu_data> JSON block marked as data. 32 tests in src/lib/agent/*.test.ts.
